nvitk.filters.snakes
====================

.. py:module:: nvitk.filters.snakes

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Kass snakes (parametric active contours).

   Wraps :func:`skimage.segmentation.active_contour`, the discrete
   implementation of Kass, Witkin & Terzopoulos (IJCV 1988). An initial
   contour (from a binary / label mask) is deformed under internal
   smoothness forces and image line/edge energies.

   Reference
   ---------
   M. Kass, A. Witkin, D. Terzopoulos,
   "Snakes: Active Contour Models",
   International Journal of Computer Vision, 1(4):321–331, 1988.

   Run Kass active contour on a single 2-D image; return refined snake.


.. py:function:: snakes_filter(image: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, init_mask: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, *, alpha: float = SNAKES_ALPHA_DEFAULT, beta: float = SNAKES_BETA_DEFAULT, w_line: float = SNAKES_W_LINE_DEFAULT, w_edge: float = SNAKES_W_EDGE_DEFAULT, gamma: float = SNAKES_GAMMA_DEFAULT, max_num_iter: int = SNAKES_MAX_ITER_DEFAULT, convergence: float = SNAKES_CONVERGENCE_DEFAULT, boundary_condition: str = 'periodic', gaussian_sigma: float = SNAKES_SIGMA_DEFAULT, n_points: int = SNAKES_N_POINTS_DEFAULT, axis: int = 0) -> nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray

   Kass snakes from an initial mask contour; returns a binary mask.

   * 2-D: deform the largest contour of *init_mask* on *image*.
   * 3-D: apply 2-D snakes independently on each slice along *axis*
     where the init mask is nonempty (Kass snakes are 2-D).

   :param image: Intensity image / volume guiding the external energy.
   :param init_mask: Binary or label mask whose contour seeds the snake (required).
   :param alpha: Tension (length) weight — higher contracts faster.
   :param beta: Rigidity (smoothness) weight — higher → smoother snake.
   :param w_line: Attraction to intensity (negative → dark regions).
   :param w_edge: Attraction to edges (negative → repel from edges).
   :param gamma: Explicit time-step size.
   :param max_num_iter: Optimization stopping criteria.
   :param convergence: Optimization stopping criteria.
   :param boundary_condition: ``periodic`` (closed), ``free``, ``fixed``, or mixed
                              (``free-fixed`` / ``fixed-free``).
   :param gaussian_sigma: Pre-smoothing of the image energy (0 disables).
   :param n_points: Number of snake control points (resampled from init contour).
   :param axis: Slice axis for 3-D volumes (ignored for 2-D).
